title: Vol'dun and Sethraliss
summary: Exile, Jakra'zet's secret plans, sethrak divisions, and the endangered Temple of Sethraliss shape the desert's campaign.
opening: Vol'dun was treated as a place of banishment, yet many peoples built lives there. General Jakra'zet's designs threatened them and the wider Zandalari realm.
reviewNote: Check the zone and dungeon quest order; do not overstate a settled political outcome. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Introduce Vol'dun's peoples and the cost of banishment. Investigate Jakra'zet's troops and intentions. Follow sethrak conflict and the people caught between factions. Review the effort to restore Sethraliss's avatar.

chapters.title: The land of exile
chapters.body: Vol’dun was a place of banishment, yet its peoples had made lives amid the desert. Exile did not leave the land empty of belonging.

chapters.title: The general's secret
chapters.body: Jakra’zet’s designs threatened those lives and the wider Zandalari realm. Behind the soldiers’ presence waited a purpose not yet fully revealed.

chapters.title: A divided people
chapters.body: Divisions among the sethrak placed others between opposing powers. The desert’s struggle reached beyond any single people.

chapters.title: The threatened temple
chapters.body: The effort to restore Sethraliss’s avatar brought the campaign toward its sacred heart. Its outcome remains unfinished in this account.
